svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 35 mm lengths of 50 x 50 x 5 angle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flat leg (goes under the rail plate): two 5.5 mm holes 30 mm out

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the upright leg's inside face, 10 and 25 mm from one end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upright leg: two 8.5 mm holes for the post bolts. Mark them from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the post: clamp the clip to the rail plate, set the post between

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the clips at the 35 degree tilt, and drill through the post holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: They fall about 12 and 21 mm from the upper end, 25 and 38 mm down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The two clips are mirror images; drill them as a pair.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: M5 screws through the rail plate, nuts under the clip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: This joint sets the panel's 35 degree tilt.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the rail plate sits at 35 degrees, give or take 1.
